## Bio
 
I am a computer science student at The University of Texas at Austin passionate about AI, data science, and human-computer interaction. I love building innovative solutions at the intersection of technology and the environment, from LLM research projects to robotics. With a background in open-source development and hands-on experimentation, I'm always exploring ways to make AI more intuitive and impactful.
